claims: Joe Pyfer defeated Israel Adesanya via second-round TKO (4:18).
Israel Adesanya is a former two-time UFC champion.
The fight occurred at UFC Fight Night 271 on March 28, 2026.
UFC Fight Night 271 took place at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle, Washington.
Adesanya vs. Pyfer is also known as UFC Fight Night 271.
Joe Pyfer secured his fourth consecutive victory.
Israel Adesanya controlled the first round with leg kicks and distance management.
In Round 2, Joe Pyfer landed heavy shots.
Joe Pyfer achieved a takedown into mount.
Joe Pyfer secured the stoppage after taking the back.
